ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF DECEMBER 12, 2017
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of December 12, 2017.
A-1 Minutes 12-12-17 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING THE CITYâ€™S COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT PROGRAM FOR FISCAL YEAR 2018-19
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing and take public testimony; and (2) adopt Resolution No. 18-5380 authorizing the Cityâ€™s CDBG Program for Fiscal Year 2018-19.
B-1 CDBG FY 2018-19 Projects Staff Report
B-1 CDBG FY 2018-19 Projects Attachment A Resolution
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
PRESENTATION AND UPDATE ON THE STATUS OF THE CITY'S EMERGENCY PREPAREDNESS PLANS
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the update.
C-1 Hazard Mitigation and Emergency Operations Plan Update Staff Report
C-2
CONSIDERATION OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH EDSA, INC. FOR SERVICES FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A PARKS MASTER PLAN IN THE AMOUNT OF $100,500.00
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the professional services agreement with EDSA, Inc. for the development of a Parks Master Plan; (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the professional services agreement on behalf of the City; and (3) authorize the appropriation of $100,500 of Lighting and Landscape Maintenance Funds from available fund balance.
C-2 EDSA Parks Master Plan Staff Report
C-2 EDSA Parks Master Plan Attachment A Agreement
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1442
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 18-5381 approving Warrant Register No. 1442.
D-1 Warrant Register #1442
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONTRACT TO LINE TECH CONTRACTORS, INC. FOR THE PARK RESTROOM IMPROVEMENT PROJECT AT LA PUENTE PARK IN THE AMOUNT OF $253,000.00
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) award the contract to Line Tech Contractors, Inc. in the amount of $253,000.00; (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement and approve change orders up to 10% of the original bid amount; and (3) authorize the appropriation of an additional $35,000 of CDBG Funds to this project.
D-2 LineTech Park Restroom Award Staff Report
D-2 LineTech Park Restroom Attachment A Agreement
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
DISCUSSION AND APPOINTMENTS BY THE MAYOR TO REGIONAL BOARDS AND CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPOINTING SPECIFIC REPRESENTATIVES TO THE SAN GABRIEL VALLEY COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS
It is recommended that: (1) the Mayor appoint representatives and delegates to the regional boards, commissions and committees; and (2) the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-5383 Appointing Specific Representatives to the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments.
E-1 Mayor Appointments Staff Report
E-1 Mayor Appointments Attachment A Resolution
C-1 Hazard Mitigation and Emergency Operations Plan Update Staff Report
E-1
DISCUSSION AND APPOINTMENTS BY THE MAYOR TO REGIONAL BOARDS AND CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPOINTING SPECIFIC REPRESENTATIVES TO THE SAN GABRIEL VALLEY COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS
It is recommended that: (1) the Mayor appoint representatives and delegates to the regional boards, commissions and committees; and (2) the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-5383 Appointing Specific Representatives to the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments.
E-2
INTRODUCTION AND CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE, CALIFORNIA, REAUTHORIZING THE CITYâ€™S PUBLIC, EDUCATIONAL, AND GOVERNMENTAL (PEG) FEES BY AMENDING CHAPTER 5.56 OF TITLE 5 (BUSINESS LICENSES AND REGULATIONS) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE, BY ADDING SECTION 5.56.130 REAUTHORIZING THE COLLECTION OF A PUBLIC, EDUCATIONAL, AND GOVERNMENTAL FEE ON STATE VIDEO FRANCHISEES OPERATING WITHIN THE CITY
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) waive reading of Ordinance No. 18-950 and read by title only; and (2) introduce Ordinance No. 18-950, an ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente, amending Chapter 5.56 of Title 5 (Business Licenses and Regulations) of the La Puente Municipal Code, by adding Section 5.56.130 reauthorizing the collection of a public, educational, and governmental fee on state video franchisees operating within the City.
E-2 PEG Fees Reauthorization Staff Report
E-2 PEG Fee Reauthorization Attachment A Ordinance

Council Members provide a report on any Ad Hoc Committee meetings that they have attended.

ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
